name: Tracing the Stars

pages.title: TRACING THE STARS
pages.text: TRACING THE STARS is a mini game where you play through songs to help T.T. STAR practice performing.

pages.title: Play Data - Profile
pages.text:
■ You can view your play data and overall ranking in the top part of the screen. 
■ Tap to see details about your achievements in TRACING THE STARS.

pages.title: Play Data - Profile
pages.text:
■ In the Profile tab, you can view the following information:

Profile
□ The ranking distribution for your server

□ Your total score
- Calculated as the sum of your highest scores from all difficulties for each song.

□ Your total play time

□ The clear status for each difficulty

□ Your total play count

□ Your average score
- Calculated by adding your highest scores for each difficulty and converting them into an average based on 1,000,000 points.

pages.title: Play Data - Profile
pages.text:
Profile
□ View the top ten songs you have played the most.

□ View the play count for each song.

pages.title: Play Data - Profile
pages.text:
Profile
□ View a graph that shows your highest rank for each song by difficulty.

pages.title: Play Data - Overall Rankings
pages.text:
■ In the Overall Rankings tab, you can view the following information:

Overall Rankings
□ Check your ranking among your friends or within your Union.

pages.title: Main Menu
pages.text:
Main Menu
□ The main menu for the mini game TRACING THE STARS.

□ Provides access to the Help, Recollections, Settings, and Missions menus.

pages.title: Main Menu
pages.text:
Help
□ View the tutorial and other detailed information for TRACING THE STARS.

pages.title: Main Menu
pages.text:
Recollections
□ Rewatch any scene you have already viewed in TRACING THE STARS.

pages.title: Main Menu
pages.text:
Settings
□ Configure different settings for TRACING THE STARS.

pages.title: Main Menu
pages.text:
Missions
□ View the available missions in TRACING THE STARS.

□ If any mission is time-limited, the remaining time will be displayed.

pages.title: Main Menu - Settings
pages.text:
Settings
□ Configure different settings for TRACING THE STARS.

□ Settings are largely divided into three categories: Gameplay, General, and Controls.

pages.title: Main Menu - Settings
pages.text:
Settings - Gameplay
□ Configure the following gameplay-related settings:

□ Speed Settings
- Adjust the speed for when playing through a song.

□ Timing Calibration
- Fine-tune the timing for your inputs when playing through a song.
- You can also press the Set button to calibrate the timing directly.

□ Set Speed Before Game
- Decide whether to show the speed setting window before starting the game.

□ Sort Order
- Adjust the sorting order for the song list.

□ Landscape Mode
- Choose whether to play in portrait or landscape mode.

pages.title: Main Menu - Settings
pages.text:
Settings - General 
□ In this menu, you can configure audio and graphics settings.
- You can adjust the overall volume, as well as the volume for the music, sound effects, tap sound, and voices.
- You can also toggle in-game video playback and adjust the background brightness.

pages.title: Main Menu - Settings
pages.text:
Settings - Controls
□ This setting only appears when playing on PC, and allows you to create or select key presets for each lane during the performance.

pages.title: Song List
pages.text:
Song List
□ Displays all songs that can be played in TRACING THE STARS.

□ You can scroll through the list and tap/click on an entry directly to choose a song.

□ On PC, you can scroll with the up and down arrow keys.
- The Page Up and Page Down keys can be used to quickly scroll past multiple songs at a time.
- You can also press a letter key to scroll to a song starting with that letter.

pages.title: Song List
pages.text:
Song List - Select Song
□ Tap the selected song's cover art in the song list to go to the ready screen.

□ The chosen song is displayed together with the following information:

□ Clear Medals
- Displays medals as cross-shaped star icons that reflect your performance on the song.

□ Difficulty
- Displays the song's difficulty.
- You can tap on a difficulty to select it.
- On PC, use the left and right arrow keys to change the difficulty.
- You can also change the selected difficulty on the ready screen.

pages.title: Song List
pages.text:
Song List - Sort
□ Use the sort feature at the bottom right of the song list to sort in the desired order.

□ On PC, press the left Shift key to quickly change the sort order.

□ Default
 - The default sort order in TRACING THE STARS.

□ Name
- Sorts alphabetically by name.

□ Difficulty
- Sorts by difficulty from hardest to easiest.

□ Clear
- Sorts by the results you've achieved from highest to lowest.
- The sort order is All Perfect - Full Combo - Cleared - Uncleared.

pages.title: Ready Screen
pages.text:
Ready Screen
□ This screen appears when you select a song from the song list.

□ Before starting the game, you can choose a difficulty or view your ranking based on your play results.

pages.title: Ready Screen
pages.text:
Ready Screen - Music Rank
□ Accessible from the ready screen by tapping the Music Rank area.

□ Here you can view your ranking among your friends / Union, as well as view your ranking on the current server for each difficulty.

pages.title: Ready Screen
pages.text:
Ready Screen - Speed Option
□ If the Set Speed Before Game setting is turned on, you can adjust the speed before starting the game.

□ If you no longer need to change the speed, you can disable this prompt in Settings - Game Play.

pages.title: Play Screen
pages.text:
Play Screen
□ Basic information is displayed in the top part of the screen, including the current song you're playing and your score.

□ The play area takes up the middle to lower parts of the screen.

pages.title: Play Screen
pages.text:
Play Screen - Upper HUD
□ When playing a song, the upper HUD shows the following:

□ Now Playing
- Information about the song you're playing is shown on the left.

□ Score & Rank
- Your current score and rank are shown in the center.

□ Current Speed & Pause
- The current speed setting is shown on the right.
- On PC, press F1/F2 to increase/decrease the speed in 0.1 increments.
- You can also open the pause menu to adjust the speed setting, exit to the music list, or restart the song.

pages.title: Play Screen
pages.text:
Play Screen - Play Area
□ This is where you can see the four note lines, the target zone, and your current combo.

□ Play in sync with the falling notes.

pages.title: Play Screen
pages.text:
Play Screen - T.T. STAR
□ Here, you can view T.T. STAR members dancing to the music.

□ They are adorable.

pages.title: Results Screen
pages.text:
Results Screen
□ After the song ends, you can view your results based on how well you did.

□ Info such as your final score, your rank based on your score, and your accuracy is displayed on this screen.

pages.title: Results Screen
pages.text:
Results Screen - Rank
□ Your rank based on your final score is displayed here.

□ From highest to lowest, the ranks are S+, S, A, B, C, and F. They are divided as follows, based on a standard of 1,000,000 points:

□ S+
100% or higher of the standard score.

□ S
95% or higher of the standard score.

□ A
90% or higher of the standard score.

□ B
80% or higher of the standard score.

□ C
70% or higher of the standard score.

□ F
Less than 70% of the standard score.

pages.title: Results Screen
pages.text:
Results Screen - Final Score
□ Your final score will be displayed here.

□ Indicators will also be shown when you set a new record, or finished with a Full Combo or All Perfect.

pages.title: Results Screen
pages.text:
Results Screen - Performance Record
□ Your accuracy/number of notes hit and combo are displayed here.

pages.title: Decorating the Stage in T.T.S.
pages.text:
T.T.S. Stage Decoration Overview
□ You can customize the different elements of the T.T.S. stage.

□ Skins enable you to change the appearance of the background, characters, and notes.

pages.title: Decorating the Stage in T.T.S.
pages.text:
Background Skins
□ Enable you to change the appearance of the background and gears.

□ The background, gears, and selection effects all get changed together.

pages.title: Decorating the Stage in T.T.S.
pages.text:
Character Skins
□ Enable you to change the appearance of the characters in the upper part of the screen.

□ Each of the three slots can be changed to a different character.

□ The same character cannot be assigned to more than one slot.

□ All slots must be filled in order to save changes.

pages.title: Decorating the Stage in T.T.S.
pages.text:
Note Skins
□ Enable you to change the appearance of normal notes and SP notes.

□ The shapes and effects of the notes all get changed together.

pages.title: Decorating the Stage in T.T.S.
pages.text:
Preview
□ Enables you to view the current background, characters, and notes in action.

□ An autoplay screen will show the current skin settings in an environment identical to actual gameplay.

pages.title: PC Shortcuts
pages.text:
Song List Shortcuts
- Changing the Sort Order
□ Shift: Changes the sort order of the song list.
□ Alt: Opens the sort order menu.

- Changing Album Packages
□ Tab: Opens the package selection menu.
- Press the key again to open the song list for the selected package.

- Quick List Navigation
□ Page Up: Moves up four songs.
□ Page Down: Moves down four songs.

- Other Menus
□ F1: Displays the help menu.
□ F2: Displays your profile.
□ F3: Displays your rating info.
□ F4: Displays the Overall Rankings tab in your profile.
□ F9: Takes you to the shop.
□ F10: Displays the story album for TRACING THE STARS.
□ F11: Displays the settings menu.
□ F12: Displays the mission list.

Ready Screen Shortcuts
- Rankings
□ F5: Displays rankings for the current song.

pages.title: PC Shortcuts
pages.text:
Play Screen Shortcuts
□ ESC: Opens the pause menu.
□ F1: Decreases the current speed by x0.1.
□ F2: Increases the current speed by x0.1.
□ F3: Decreases the background video opacity by 10.
□ F4: Increases the background video opacity by 10.
□ F5: Restarts the current song from the beginning.
